lines.line: Summary: A flying enemy that turns up in many areas, from King's Pass and the Forgotten Crossroads to Greenpath and the City of Tears. It drifts around a small stretch of air, squawks when you come into range, then flies straight at you. It is an easy enemy that shows up early.

quoted: Vengeflies can be found in the Howling Cliffs, King's Pass, the Forgotten Crossroads, Greenpath, the City of Tears, the Colosseum of Fools, and the Blue Lake.
Hovers in the air, moving around a small area. Emits a squawk before homing in on the Knight when they come in range.
One of the first and easiest enemies in the game.

lines.line: Weak points: You can stand still and swing as it reaches you, or leap and attack downward onto it.

quoted: Either wait and strike when it gets within range, or jump and strike down at it.
Either way, it will continue to move towards the Knight

lines.line: Tips: It never stops coming for you, so you can stay put and keep attacking until it falls. Only a few enemies reappear when you leave a room and come back, and this is one of them.

quoted: making it possible to stay in one place and continue attacking until it is dead.
The Vengefly is one of the few enemies that respawns upon leaving and re-entering the room.

lines.line: Summary: A floating enemy that wanders aimlessly until you approach, then spits blobs at you from a distance. It usually comes in groups. You meet it in the Forgotten Crossroads and in the western part of the Ancient Basin's tram tunnel.

quoted: Aspid Hunters usually hunt in packs and spit corrosive liquid at prey from a distance.
Aimlessly hovers around until approached by the Knight. It attacks from a distance by spitting blobs of corrosive liquid.
Aspid Hunters can be found in the Forgotten Crossroads (mainly the area where the Glowing Womb Charm is collected) and in the west side of the Ancient Basin Tram tunnel.

lines.line: Weak points: A short opening follows each spit, and the best response is to rush in close and hit it straight away.

quoted: After it spits, there is a small window to attack. It is best to get in close and strike as soon as possible.

lines.line: Tips: Its wings make a whirring noise that carries a long way, so you can tell one is near before it comes into view. A stronger version, the Primal Aspid, is found in Kingdom's Edge. Leave the room and return, and it will be back, which few enemies do.

quoted: They can easily be heard from a distance by the whirring sound their wings make.
A more powerful variant called Primal Aspids can be found in Kingdom's Edge.
The Aspid Hunter is one of the few enemies that respawns upon leaving and re-entering the room.

lines.line: Summary: A husk with a club that stays where it stands until disturbed, then charges you. The Forgotten Crossroads holds only two: one just east of the False Knight's arena and one right above the north entrance to Crystal Peak.

quoted: Stands in place until disturbed. Once engaged, it rushes into battle, using two attacks:
Raises its club and smashes it down
they still instinctively guard their former posts.
Only two are found in the Forgotten Crossroads, one east of the False Knight arena and the other right above the north Crystal Peak entrance.

lines.line: Weak points: Strike right after its club slam, which is when it can be hurt. When it sends out its shockwave, jump over the wave, move in and you can usually land one or two hits. You can also tap it once and step out of reach before the club swings down, though the timing is tight and the Mothwing Cloak helps once you have it.

quoted: After it uses its club, it can be damaged.
It is usually possible to jump towards the Husk Guard and get one or two hits in after this attack.
It is possible to hit the Husk Guard once, then run out of its range before it can bring down its club, however, the window to strike is quite small. This is easier later on with the Mothwing Cloak.

lines.line: Tips: The club slam does two masks of damage. The backward hop throws a shockwave out to both sides along the ground, growing wider and faster as it travels. The guard you meet before the False Knight can be hit safely from the platform on the right. Each one drops 45 Geo, a lot this early, and both stand near the Stag Station, so they make an easy early source of Geo. Fight the one by the False Knight's arena soon, because it cannot be fought later in the game.

quoted: This attack deals two masks of damage.
Hops backwards, creating shockwaves that travel horizontally both left and right. These increase in width and speed as they travel.
The Husk Guard met before facing False Knight can be damaged from a safe zone, by going on the platform to the right.
Husk Guards drop 45, a very high amount for an early game enemy, and can be used to farm Geo early on. Both guards are located conveniently close to the Stag Station in the Forgotten Crossroads.
Once the Forgotten Crossroads changes to the Infected Crossroads, the Husk Guard near the arena of the False Knight is overcome by the Infection and cannot be fought anymore.

lines.line: Summary: A walking corpse armed with a greatnail. It guards the City of Tears, where a small number are found, and two more stand in the eastern Royal Waterways.

quoted: these walking corpses wield a greatnail, guarding the City of Tears even in death.
They are mainly found within the City of Tears, in small numbers. Two can be found in the eastern part of the Royal Waterways.

lines.line: Weak points: The best opening is during its charge: jump over it and strike downward, or cast Vengeful Spirit or Shade Soul, which it cannot avoid. A hit just after its plain overhead swing works too.

quoted: The best moment to hit them is when they charge.
Simply jump over them and execute a downward strike or use the Vengeful Spirit/Shade Soul Spell when they charge, as they have no way to avoid it.
They can also be hit just after their normal Overhead Swing attack.

lines.line: Tips: Its three attacks are an overhead swing, a charge with its nail held out in front, and a hop. If you try to jump over it, it hops up in reply, hurting on contact and then swinging down as it lands.

quoted: Heavy Sentries have three attacks:
They charge at the Knight with their nail held in front of them.
When the Knight attempts jumping over them, they react by hopping in the air, dealing contact damage. As they land on the ground, they perform an Overhead Swing attack.

lines.line: Summary: A young mantis, one of the Mantis Tribe's children, that waits on a wall or the ceiling to ambush you. It is found only in Mantis Village and at its entrance.

quoted: They are young children of the Mantis Tribe, losing their ability to fly when becoming adults.
Waits, clinging to a wall or ceiling to ambush the Knight.
They can only be found within and at the entrance of the Mantis Village.

lines.line: Tips: When it notices you, it floats just outside nail range, winds up and lunges at you. The lunge covers little distance and is simple to avoid, but it drifts out of reach again straight away to wind up another one. Leave the room and return, and it will be back, which few enemies do.

quoted: Once engaged, it hovers around just out of range of Nail attacks before winding up and lunging towards the Knight.
Their range is short and easy to dodge, but they quickly hover out of range to charge up another attack.
The Mantis Youth is one of the few enemies that respawns upon leaving and re-entering the room.

lines.line: Summary: A scholar from the Soul Sanctum that teleports about and shoots homing orbs at you. It is found east of the Soul Master's arena, and in the Trial of the Fool, during waves 9, 10, 11 and 17.

quoted: They are scholars of the Soul Sanctum who have learnt how to harness the power of SOUL, which they twist into spells and use to teleport.
it pursues the Knight by teleporting and conjuring homing offensive orbs to attack with.
They appear in the Soul Sanctum, only to the east of the Soul Master arena. They also appear in the 9th, 10th, 11th and 17th waves of the Trial of the Fool.

lines.line: Weak points: It cannot teleport right after it fires, so let it shoot, dodge the orb by jumping over it or dashing, then run in and hit it. Great Slash, one of the Nail Arts, kills it quickly, and Dash Slash helps you cover the distance. Vengeful Spirit and Shade Soul also work from range, since it does not deliberately teleport away from them.

quoted: the best tactic then is to wait for the Soul Twister to conjure an offensive orb and then rush in to attack it after avoiding its projectile, as it cannot teleport immediately after firing a projectile.
avoiding the orb can be as simple as jumping over or dashing.
It is recommended to use Nail Arts such as Great Slash to dispatch them quickly. Dash Slash can also help close the range with them.
Vengeful Spirit/Shade Soul is also useful for attacking at range, as they do not deliberately teleport to avoid projectiles.

lines.line: Tips: It teleports a lot and cannot be cornered. Luring it into small rooms or narrow halls leaves it fewer angles to attack from, so its orbs are easier to predict and you land more hits. Running away is very hard because it keeps teleporting after you, but it will not follow you through a screen transition into another room.

quoted: It teleports frequently around its territory, making it difficult to hit and impossible to corner.
Forcing them into smaller rooms and hallways where they have fewer angles of attack is also recommended to make dodging more predictable, and to make it easier to get in hits.

Fleeing from these enemies is very difficult, as they relentlessly teleport after the Knight upon their activation. However, they do not follow the Knight into other rooms marked via a screen transition.

lines.line: Summary: A floating enemy found nowhere but Crystal Peak. It usually keeps out of melee range and shoots crystals at you.

quoted: Crystal Hunters can be found only in Crystal Peak.
Hovers in the air, usually out of melee range, shooting a crystalline projectile at the Knight

lines.line: Weak points: Its shots come out after a short delay, so they usually miss you unless you are right underneath it. Leap up and slash at it while it is getting its next shot ready.

quoted: Unless the Knight is directly below them, they tend to miss their attacks as they launch them with a short delay. Jump up and slash at them while they are preparing their next attack.

lines.line: Tips: When its shot lands on a surface it bursts into a clump of crystals. The clump disappears after a short time, breaks easily with a nail hit, and can be bounced off with a nail strike. You can also knock the shot itself away with the nail, though it still passes through enemies.

quoted: turns into a cluster of crystals when it makes contact with a surface.
These clusters dissipate after a short period of time but can otherwise easily be broken with a Nail strike, and can be Nail-bounced on.
Their crystal shot can be deflected with a Nail strike, but the projectile still passes through enemies.

lines.line: Summary: The full-grown Hopper: a large enemy that hops nonstop, hurting you on contact and shaking the ground whenever it lands. You find it in the southeast of Kingdom's Edge and during the Trial of the Conqueror, and the dummy in Oro's backyard sets two on you when struck.

quoted: The adult form of the Hopper, these large creatures attempt to crush prey beneath their bodies.
Hops continuously up and down, dealing contact damage and shaking the ground when it lands.

They are found in the southeast part of Kingdom's Edge. Two of them are spawned by hitting the dummy in Oro's backyard. They are also found within the Colosseum of Fools, in the Trial of the Conqueror.

lines.line: Weak points: Stay put and shuffle slightly sideways so each jump misses you, and each time it lands you can strike it safely. Howling Wraiths or Abyss Shriek can hit it while it is still in the air.

quoted: When standing in one place and moving slightly to the side to avoid its jumps, it is possible to hit it after every landing without taking damage.
The Howling Wraiths/Abyss Shriek Spell can be used to damage them while they are in the air.

lines.line: Tips: Touching it hurts. It swings round to go after you, which a regular Hopper does not do.

quoted: dealing contact damage
Unlike normal Hoppers, it changes direction to chase the Knight.

lines.line: Summary: A young, crawling creature that defends itself by curling into a ball, which it rolls toward you. It lives in the Howling Cliffs, the Ancestral Mound and the Crystallised Mound; a stronger kind, the Sharp Baldur, shows up at the Colosseum of Fools.

quoted: They are younger Baldurs and crawling creatures who defend themselves by rolling into a ball. A stronger variant called the Sharp Baldur is bred to fight in the Colosseum of Fools.
They are found in the Ancestral Mound, Crystallised Mound, and the Howling Cliffs.

lines.line: Weak points: Jump over it as it closes in and strike down while you are above it. The Heavy Blow charm or the Quick Slash charm can instead keep knocking it back so it never touches you.

quoted: Jump over it when it gets close and strike from above while doing so.
using the Quick Slash or Heavy Blow Charm allow the Knight to continually knock it back before it can make contact.

lines.line: Tips: In its ball form it rebounds off the walls and off other Baldurs, then after a little while it opens up and turns toward you again.

quoted: Rolls into a ball and propels itself towards the Knight, bouncing off walls and other Baldurs. After a short time, it uncurls and reorients itself to face the Knight again.

lines.line: Looks like: Its eyes are orange in the game.

quoted: their eyes during gameplay are orange

lines.line: Summary: A boss that sleeps in a small arena in the Forgotten Crossroads, blocking the direct way down to an abandoned village. A hit wakes her, and the Trial of the Warrior finishes with two more of her at once.

quoted: Gruz Mother is found sleeping in a small arena.

One Gruz Mother can be found blocking the direct path to an abandoned village at the bottom of the Forgotten Crossroads. She is sleeping, exhausted from carrying her children, and wakes up when struck.
Two more Gruz Mothers can be fought simultaneously at the end of the Trial of the Warrior.

lines.line: Weak points: Her health is low, and Vengeful Spirit is the easiest tool against her: six casts, or 18 strikes with the Old Nail, will finish her.

quoted: Using the Vengeful Spirit Spell is the easiest way to defeat her, as she has relatively low health (6 Vengeful Spirits/18 Old Nail strikes is enough to defeat Gruz Mother).

lines.line: Tips: Her Wild Slam, in which she throws herself again and again between floor and ceiling, is fast and needs decent timing to avoid, which the Mothwing Cloak helps with. When she dies in the Crossroads she releases a swarm of 7 or 8 Gruzzers, and you must kill them all before you can leave the arena. In the Trial of the Warrior two come at once: kill one as fast as you can, and Abyss Shriek or Howling Wraiths works best.

quoted: Wild Slam: Gruz Mother repeatedly slams herself between the floor and the ceiling
The Wild Slam attack can be dodged more easily with the Mothwing Cloak since the attack is fast and decent timing is required to avoid it otherwise.
When Gruz Mother dies in her Forgotten Crossroads encounter, she spawns a swarm of 7-8 Gruzzers that must also be defeated before the Knight can leave the boss area.
In the Colosseum of Fools, two are fought at once. It is best to kill one Gruz Mother as fast as possible
Howling Wraiths/Abyss Shriek is the best Spell to defeat Gruz Mother in the Colosseum of Fools.

lines.line: Summary: An item that helps you see in dark areas. Sly sells it in Dirtmouth for 1800 Geo.

quoted: The Lumafly Lantern is an Item in Hollow Knight.
In dark areas, the Lumafly Lantern brightens up the area around the Knight, giving more visibility
Can be purchased from Sly in Dirtmouth for 1800.

lines.line: Uses: In dark areas it also lets you pay tolls that open benches and doors.

quoted: giving more visibility and allowing them to pay tolls to open Benches or doors.

lines.line: Tips: The toll gate between the Forgotten Crossroads and Crystal Peak cannot be used without it, in either direction, so buy it before you try to cross. It is not used in four areas: the Hive, Kingdom's Edge, Fog Canyon and Fungal Wastes.

quoted: it is strictly required in order to interact with the toll gate leading from the Forgotten Crossroads to Crystal Peak and the other way around
The Lumafly Lantern is not used in Fog Canyon, Fungal Wastes, Kingdom's Edge, and the Hive.

lines.line: Summary: Items that make your SOUL meter bigger. Every three fragments you gather combine into a Soul Vessel that adds 33 to your maximum. There are nine in the game, so three vessels in all, which doubles the SOUL you can hold.

quoted: Vessel Fragments are Items in Hollow Knight that increase the Knight's maximum SOUL.

Three Vessel Fragments are combined to form a Soul Vessel, which increases the Knight's maximum SOUL by 33. There are a total of 9 Vessel Fragments in the game, allowing the Knight to acquire 3 Soul Vessels, doubling the maximum amount of SOUL that can be carried (99 + (33 x 3)).

lines.line: Uses: SOUL kept in the vessels flows into the main meter on its own, after a short pause, whenever the main meter has space. Hitting enemies with the nail puts only 6 SOUL per hit into the vessels; any other way of getting SOUL fills them at the usual rate.

quoted: When the main Soul meter has empty space, any SOUL stored in the Vessels will automatically fill up the main meter after a short delay.
The Nail acquires SOUL for the Soul Vessels at a reduced rate of 6 SOUL per hit.
All other sources of SOUL fill Soul Vessels at their normal rate.

lines.line: Tips: Sly in Dirtmouth sells two, for 550 Geo and 900 Geo; you must have found Sly in the Forgotten Crossroads first, and the second also needs the Shopkeeper's Key. The Seer gives one for 700 Essence, and the Ancient Basin fountain gives one when you drop 3000 Geo into it. Others lie in the world: one in Greenpath near the Queen's Gardens entrance that you cannot enter, one beside the lift in the Forgotten Crossroads once the City of Tears lift is unlocked, one near a lift above King's Station, and one in Deepnest over the tram that works.

quoted: Bought from Sly in Dirtmouth for 550
Requires finding Sly in Forgotten Crossroads
Bought from Sly in Dirtmouth for 900
Requires both finding Sly and having the Shopkeeper's Key
Given by the Seer
Collecting 700 Essence
Found in the fountain in Ancient Basin
Dropping 3000 into the fountain
Found in Greenpath near the inaccessible Queen's Gardens entrance
Left of the lift in Forgotten Crossroads
Unlocking the lift in the City of Tears
Found above King's Station near a lift
Found in Deepnest above the working tram

lines.line: Summary: A charm that makes you focus SOUL about a third faster. Salubra sells it for 800 Geo, in the Forgotten Crossroads.

quoted: Quick Focus is a Charm in Hollow Knight. It makes focusing SOUL ~33% faster.
Bought from Salubra in the Forgotten Crossroads for 800.

lines.line: Uses: Healing mid-fight becomes much more forgiving. It can let you heal in spots where you would otherwise get interrupted, or heal twice where you could normally manage only one. The short start-up before a focus begins is not made any faster.

quoted: it makes healing in the middle of combat much more forgiving.
Allows healing where it is possible to get interrupted while Focusing or healing twice in situations where normally it is only possible to heal once.
Startup time is not affected by Quick Focus.

lines.line: Tips: It is most useful in fights with a lot of combat, such as bosses and arena fights like the Colosseum of Fools. With Deep Focus, which slows focusing, it cancels part of that slowdown, though the two together cost 7 notches. With Stalwart Shell, the invincibility lasts just long enough for you to focus and heal, and pairing it with Soul Catcher or Soul Eater makes healing more frequent and safer.

quoted: Extremely useful in situations with lots of combat such as boss fights and arenas (notably the Colosseum of Fools).
Despite costing a prohibitive 7 Notches combined, Quick Focus partially cancels the Focus-speed penalty of Deep Focus
Stalwart Shell
Useful as it provides just enough time to Focus and heal during the invincibility.
Combining with Soul Catcher allows for more frequent, safer healing.
Combining with Soul Eater allows for more frequent, safer healing.

lines.line: Summary: A charm that shows where you are on the map. Iselda in Dirtmouth sells it for 220 Geo once you have met Cornifer.

quoted: It shows the location of the Knight on the Map.
Bought from Iselda in Dirtmouth for 220 after the first encounter with Cornifer.

lines.line: Uses: The map marks where you are standing, including in areas whose map you have not bought yet.

quoted: The location of the Knight is shown even when no map of the area has been bought.

lines.line: Tips: It suits exploring, especially on a first playthrough. Before a boss fight, put on a charm built for combat instead.

quoted: This Charm is useful for exploration and is good during a first playthrough. It is recommended to switch to something more combat-oriented when preparing for a boss battle.

lines.line: Summary: An item found in a wrecked tram, in Deepnest's Failed Tramway. It lets you ride the trams.

quoted: Found in the Failed Tramway in Deepnest inside the wreck of a tram.
Allows the Knight to ride the Tram.

lines.line: Uses: Each tram needs the pass only once, put into the tram's door or into a mechanism at any of its stations. If you use a station mechanism while no tram is there, even for a tram you have not yet activated, it both switches the tram on and calls it to you.

quoted: It only needs to be inserted once per Tram, either the Tram door or one of its station mechanisms, to activate it.
Inserting the Tram Pass into a station mechanism when a Tram isn't there, even if it hasn't been activated before, both activates and summons the Tram to the Knight's location.

lines.line: Tips: Five places take the pass. North of Gruz Mother's arena, in the south-east Forgotten Crossroads, it starts the tram to the Resting Grounds. In the north-west Resting Grounds it starts the tram back to the Crossroads. East of the Hot Spring, in south-east Deepnest, it starts the tram to the Ancient Basin. North of Cornifer, in the north-east Ancient Basin, it starts the tram to both Deepnest and Kingdom's Edge. And west of the Hive, in the south-west of Kingdom's Edge, it starts the tram to the Ancient Basin.

quoted: There are five locations where a Tram Pass can be used:
Southeastern Forgotten Crossroads, north of Gruz Mother's arena.
Tram that travels to the Resting Grounds.
Northwestern Resting Grounds, west of Xero's arena.
Tram that travels to the Forgotten Crossroads.
Southeastern Deepnest, east of the Hot Spring.
Tram that travels to Ancient Basin.
Northeastern Ancient Basin, north of Cornifer.
Tram that travels to Deepnest and Kingdom's Edge.
Southwestern Kingdom's Edge, west of the Hive.
